# National Agriculture in the Classroom

> A comprehensive K-12 agricultural literacy platform providing educators with standards-based curriculum resources, lesson plans, and professional development to integrate agriculture education across all subject areas.

National Agriculture in the Classroom (NAITC) serves as the central hub for connecting educators with agricultural learning resources and connecting them to state affiliate programs nationwide. The organization supports agricultural literacy through curriculum matrices, interactive games, virtual field experiences, and teacher recognition programs.

## Key Topics

- Agricultural Literacy
- K-12 Education
- Agriculture Curriculum
- Standards-Based Learning
- Lesson Plans

## Core Educational Resources

- [Curriculum Matrix](https://agclassroom.org/matrix): National Agricultural Literacy Curriculum Matrix with standards-based K-12 lesson plans and classroom activities.
- [Educational Resources Hub](https://agclassroom.org/educational-resources): Hub for educational resources including NALOs, certification programs, and virtual farm tours.
- [Ag Games and AgBadging](https://agclassroom.org/ag-games): Interactive Ag Games and AgBadging Field Guide for youth engagement and career exploration.
- [Agricultural Statistics and Facts](https://agclassroom.org/educational-resources/stats-facts): Agricultural statistics and state-specific facts for classroom use and reference.

## Organization and Leadership

- [Homepage](https://agclassroom.org): Homepage for National Agriculture in the Classroom (AITC), providing K-12 educators with agricultural literacy resources.
- [About National Agriculture in the Classroom](https://agclassroom.org/about): About page describing NAITC organization, leadership team, and mission overview.
- [Mission and Vision](https://agclassroom.org/mission): Mission and vision statement of NAITCO and organizational structure overview.

## Professional Development and Events

- [National Conference](https://agclassroom.org/conference): National Agriculture in the Classroom Conference registration and professional development event information.
- [Excellence in Teaching Awards](https://agclassroom.org/awards): Excellence in Teaching about Agriculture Award and teacher recognition programs.

## State Programs and Affiliates

- [State Affiliate Contact Directory](https://agclassroom.org/affiliates/programs): Directory of state affiliate contacts and Agriculture in the Classroom programs nationwide.
